title: Scratch is one struct instead of an enum over DiskScratch and a Vec
body:
`Scratch<W>` in `libsufr/src/build/scratch.rs` is the build's staging for the unsorted buckets and the sorted partitions, in memory or in a temp file by `ScratchKind`. It is the enum from before `sufr-cad4f6`, put back by 80d74c0 after the `Buffer` trait was split into `Source` and this.

- `Scratch` is an enum that forwards `extend_from_slice`, `flush`, `count` and `consume` to `DiskScratch` or to a `Vec`, and `DiskScratch` holds its own `Vec` as the pending tail.
- `DiskScratch::open` creates the temp file with `NamedTempFile::new` then `keep`, so the path is a `PathBuf` removed by hand in `consume` and again in `Drop`.
- `read` returns a `Cow` that `consume` turns into a `Vec` either way, copying the tail where a move would do, and sizes the read from the file's metadata when `count` is known.

## Proposal

One struct: a `Vec` of pending values, an `Option<TempPath>` created at the first flush and removed on drop, the count written, and the kind. The memory kind never flushes. `consume` reads `count` values from the file and moves the tail in. The lazy creation stays: a DNA build has up to 32768 buckets, most empty, and creating a file per bucket up front cost 15% of a build when `sufr-cad4f6` tried it.

## Cost

`partition` and `sort_partition` are hot loops, so the build goes on the board before and after.
